cell_center_formula: x = origin_x + (col + 0.5) * cell_m ; y = origin_y + (row + 0.5) * cell_m
height_is: surface z in `frame` minus z_datum_m (z_datum_m = z of the support plane)
counts_is: number of surface samples reduced into the cell

empty_cell.consumer_note: use `valid`; the fill value is padding, not a measurement.  `counts` is sample support only — on the particle path counts==0 is a valid floor reading, not a hole

agg_rule: exact closed-form maximum over the cell footprint
note: cells no sphere overhangs report floor_z_m and stay valid; counts is the number of spheres reaching the cell rectangle
